scenicChapters.title: Transfagarasan Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 33 km this is Transfagarasan Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Transfăgărășan
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 17 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

road-transfagarasan-highway.story: 166 km from Curtea de Argeş to Curtea de Argeş, about 2 h 46 of riding. On the way it passes Vidraru Dam, Balea Lake, Cartisoara and back through Balea Lake. The highest point is about 2,050 m. Balea Lake is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off.

scenicChapters.title: Col de Montgenevre
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2642 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 81 km. 607 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

route-des-grandes-alpes-col-du-galibier-.story: 281 km one way from Valloire - plan on about 4 h 43 of riding. It goes by way of Col d Izoard and Col de Vars. The highest point is 2,715 m.
